entries.9e1d15fe31f516ba: Standalone game development and sales company
entries.a241f1eb2d3fd05b: It states a basic policy of creating original game content and services full of originality, by respecting individual creativity and maximizing its effects through teamwork. Over the medium to long term, it states that it will build a management foundation with a good balance of offense and defense, based on its accumulated know-how and brand; as the core of “offense,” it will take on new fields and innovate development technology, and as the core of “defense,” it will work on further improving speed and quality and on developing people. In addition, it states that it will effectively carry out in-house development and licensing in Japan and overseas, and expand widely across various platforms to raise brand awareness.

entries.a9cfc5d9c105fe00: This is a single-segment business that plans, produces, develops and sells game software. It operates through two divisions, the Product Division and the License Division, and revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥2,612 million. Its head office is located in Tachikawa, Tokyo, and its only business location is the head office (1 location). It had 69 employees as of September 30, 2025.
